notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal noncombat damage to an opponent who controls at least one creature.
description:
Deal noncombat damage to an opponent.
Chandra's Incinerator triggers, dealing that much damage to a creature the opponent controls.
Repercussion triggers, causing the creature to deal damage equal to the damage dealt to it to its controller.
Repeat from step 2 until the opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life, or until the opponent controls no creatures.
If you have a repeated way to deal noncombat damage to any other opponent(s) who control a creature, you may repeat this loop for those opponents.
